args.task: Identify the number of affordable housing units constructed, started, or financed in NYC under Mayor Zohran Mamdani in 2026, and whether there are metrics tracking the progress toward the 200,000 affordable homes goal.

result:
* In 2026 (from January 1, 2026, through the September 30, 2026 update), HPD recorded 11,585 affordable housing units across 539 projects with a project start date ([NYC Open Data: Affordable Housing Production by Building](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/hg8x-zxpr)).
* For baseline comparison, in full year 2025, HPD recorded 29,277 affordable housing units across 854 projects with a project start date ([NYC Open Data: Affordable Housing Production by Building](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/hg8x-zxpr)).
* Regarding housing completions, 15,660 affordable housing units across 474 projects reached building completion in 2026 up to September 30 ([NYC Open Data: Affordable Housing Production by Building](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/hg8x-zxpr)).
* In full year 2025, 25,697 affordable housing units across 792 projects reached building completion ([NYC Open Data: Affordable Housing Production by Building](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/hg8x-zxpr)).
* The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) tracks affordable housing production progress via its publicly updated datasets (such as `hg8x-zxpr` and `hq68-rnsi`), which measure units started and completed under the city's housing plans ([NYC Open Data: Affordable Housing Production by Building](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/hg8x-zxpr)).

* Mayor Zohran Kwame Mamdani released his housing plan on May 26, 2026, titled *Block by Block: The Housing Plan for a New Era*, which sets a twin target to build 200,000 new affordable homes and preserve another 200,000 existing affordable homes over the next decade ([NYC Mayor's Office](https://www.nyc.gov/mayors-office/news/2026/05/mayor-mamdani-releases--block-by-block--the-housing-plan-for-a-n)).

* Deputy Mayor for Housing and Planning Leila Bozorg and Housing Commissioner Dina Levy joined Mayor Mamdani to announce the blueprint, which incorporates transit-oriented zoning reforms, fast-tracking tools, and an expansion of the Open Door program ([NYC Mayor's Office](https://www.nyc.gov/mayors-office/news/2026/05/mayor-mamdani-releases--block-by-block--the-housing-plan-for-a-n)).
